name: offline-ai-coding-brain
purpose: A complete, legally downloadable, locally-runnable software stack that reproduces the capabilities of an AI coding system: reason, plan, write/understand/search/modify/debug/review/test code, run commands, use a terminal and filesystem, research and browse the web, coordinate agents, and remember project context.

reason: reasoning: DSPy, Outlines, guidance, Guardrails AI, self-consistency pattern
think-through-coding-problems: reasoning: LangGraph reflect loop, DSPy, verification venv
write-code: agents: aider, gpt-engineer, gptme, plandex, codex-cli, gemini-cli, opencode
search-a-codebase: coding-tools: ripgrep, ast-grep, universal-ctags, GNU global
review-code: reasoning: semgrep, reviewdog, bandit, ruff, pyright
test-code: coding-tools: hyperfine, pytest, jest/vitest via node
research-technical-information: research-tools: SearXNG, ddgr, trafilatura, tldr, DevDocs
use-a-browser: browser-tools: Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, browser-use, Stagehand
inspect-websites: browser-tools: CDP (chrome-remote-interface), lynx, w3m, htmlq, xmllint
coordinate-agents: source: source/freebuff/agents (file-explorer, editor, thinker, researcher, reviewer, librarian, basher)
remember-project-context: context/memory: mem0, Letta, cognee, LangGraph sqlite checkpoints
execute-coding-tasks: agents: aider, OpenHands, SWE-agent, Goose, plandex
build-applications: agents: gpt-engineer, OpenHands, codex-cli; supporting: node/bun/python/rust toolchains

licenses_note: Every component here is open source or open weight. Model licenses are listed in models/manifest.json; several (Llama, Gemma) are gated and require accepting the license on Hugging Face and authenticating with `hf auth login`.
